roles.title: Role Management
roles.subtitle: Manage the list of user roles in your office.
roles.createDescription: A new role is created with no permissions. Permissions are configured in a later step.

roles.emptyDescription: No roles have been created. Create the first one to start configuring user permissions.

users.title: User Management
users.subtitle: Manage the user accounts in your office.
users.createDescription: A new account is created with no roles or permissions. Roles are configured in a later step.
users.editDescription: Changing these details affects neither the person's roles and permissions nor their password.
users.phoneHint: Optional. Write it however your office normally does.
users.emptyDescription: No user accounts have been created. Add the first one to get started.
users.disableDescription: "{name}" will not be able to sign in until the account is enabled again.
users.enableDescription: "{name}" will be able to sign in again.
